body: The wound is in belief and meaning; a faith, education, or worldview that failed you.
business: You help others find meaning that actually holds.
shadow: Preaching a borrowed certainty, or refusing to believe in anything.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
